title: OpenClaw Releases 2026.9.5 With Atomic Updates, Plugin Hot Reload, Conversation Sharing, and Expanded GPT Live
summary: OpenClaw 2026.9.5 ships 4,179 pull requests from 502 contributing accounts. The headline change is Atomic Updates, which check the next version against a private copy of your setup while the current Gateway keeps running. The release also adds plugin hot reload, read-only conversation sharing, GPT Live in meetings and calls, shared browser pages, archiving, and guided specialist-agent setup.
